comment: FlareID accepts only signed request objects (RFC 9101): request_object_signing_alg_values_supported lists RS256/ES256 without 'none', so the module skips - an unsigned object can neither be accepted nor exercised.
As above: unsigned objects are rejected, and the module skips when 'none' is not in request_object_signing_alg_values_supported.
As above: the module passes an unsigned request object, so it skips when 'none' is not advertised.
id_token_signing_alg_values_supported deliberately omits 'none'; the module skips when unsigned id_tokens are not advertised.
